decisions.reason: As a flagship product close to the firm’s core dosimetry and QA offer and highlighted on the home page, it likely meets or is given time to meet aspirations, and the firm’s growth and slack support continued commitment.

Because it builds on the established oncology QA software base and the firm is expanding in a growing R&D-intensive industry, management would likely retain it despite somewhat greater uncertainty and continue searching for improvement rather than drop it quickly.
